selection: The same frozen snapshot and managed capability membership as v1. Provisioned tokens, runtime projections, examples and receipts are not promoted to managed semantic authority.

selectors.aliases: Identical source bytes and compatible source scope add definition lineage, never entity copies. An appearance is fully supported only when its representative was fully supported.
selectors.schemas: Standalone .schema.json documents or schemas declaring a json-schema.org metaschema are content-addressed SchemaObjects. An arbitrary instance with a $schema reference is not a schema. This does not mint a Contract ID.
selectors.shared: The agentic and feature-authoring contract catalogs, interfaces, execution authorities and transformations are shared library declarations. Their namespace bindings are explicit above; capsule containment does not make a new shared entity.
selectors.authority: Root authorityId plus an explicit authorityType, policyType or profileType, excluding schema, receipt, conformance and evidence documents. Preserve the declaration's complete canonical semantics and source status.
selectors.provider: sfx-process-runtime.v1 declares providerId and a capabilities map. Exact mapped capability authority bytes must resolve before a provider_capability_implementation is inserted. profileId alone is a reference, not a Provider Profile definition.
selectors.blueprint: canonical-circuit-blueprint.v1 inside managed capsules. capabilityAuthorityDigest is the exact feature authority digest in this historical profile. It must resolve to a feature already contributing to the selected capability definition. Nodes map by explicit node ID; scenario faces map only if all three explicit face IDs and the same capability agree. Missing digest-pinned binding authority, Product or exact face stays a typed unresolved observation; no fabricated endpoint is inserted. These are partial observed blueprint definitions, not an admission or graph-conformance claim.

blueprintFanOut: A fanOutSetId is declared by the blueprint itself and does not depend on edge binding authority, so the declared set loads with its blueprint. Its members are edges, so fan-out membership is only established when an edge resolves.
sourceBoundary: A reference alone does not declare Product, Mechanic, Provider Profile, Provider or an authority definition. Parsed fixture payloads and expression literal objects are values, not independent entities.
coverage: One replacement classification per appearance. Partial sources remain unsupported or ambiguous. SUPPORTED means the profile mapping is complete, not that all referenced source facts are valid. Explicit source-reference gaps are counted separately from missing importer profiles.
